race.comment: AVENUE MONTAIGNE (16) is a very progressive filly who needed the run when finishing fourth here 18 days ago when making her Queensland debut after previously racing in Victoria, winning her maiden at Pakenham in April. The extra 200m is the key, and with 3.5kg less to carry, she can take this out. HOT DIGITY BOOM (12) resumes for a new stable after relocating from Victoria earlier in the year. He may need the run, but he has trialled up nicely, and is sure to be ready to rumble. Follow any market leads. STOKOMO (10) caught the eye when narrowly beaten in a small field over 1200m at a Oak Park picnic meeting first-up and should take plenty of benefit from that outing. Include in all combos. KIRIKAN (13) continues to race honestly and wasn't far away when finishing fourth over 1400m at Cairns last start. Top 4 claims in this field. BETTERLUCKNEXTTIME (4) needed the run fresh up as the favourite when making his Queensland debut at Ingham 3 weeks ago. Follow your money.
